title: Hynek's swamp gas explanation

tellings.quote: Uh Heinik was the person who came up with the swamp gas thing.

plain: In the 1960s the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, who advised the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, was the one who came up with the "swamp gas" explanation: the idea that lights people reported came from gas rising off a marsh. The UFO skeptic Mick West points this out in passing, as a reminder of who was behind one of the best-known official explanations for a sighting.
